profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: AI agentic systems enthusiast, smart, humble and adaptable IT professional with over 10 years' experience in software development. Passionate about designing, building and operating the best and most challenging software products on the market. Fluent in Python, C#, TDD, Design Patterns, NodeJs, Prompt engineering. Most important personal values include teamwork, integrity and honesty.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and implement autonomous agent systems, prompt engineering, Langgraph, optimizing agent performance, LLM APIs, agent frameworks, Python, ML frameworks.
Responsible for designing, developing, planning, and leading cross team engineering projects.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for designing, improving, architecting and developing web applications.
Implemented a highly successful search view page, reducing the search latency by 95%.
Solved a CPU coding bottleneck, increasing the application scalability by 30%.

positions.title: Technical Fellow
positions.description:
Responsible for designing, improving, architecting and developing cloud, web, mobile and client/server applications
Implemented a cloud mobile shop for a museum, greatly increasing its income.
Implemented an HTML5 end-to-end near real-time web monitoring application, identifying and reducing the amount of daily application errors by 90%.
Automated the first Continuous Integration Cycle for a web banking application, reducing integration issues between 6 development teams involving more than 50 developers.

positions.title: Development Premier Field Engineer - .NET C#, Microsoft Azure
positions.description:
Responsible for reviewing and improving cloud and web applications working with operation and development teams.
Solved an important security breach, avoiding the disclosure of the financial information of thousands web application users.
